source_audit_basis.audit_assessment: E1 has a real OOS tracking engine. E1R currently has separate scaffolding scripts for status/equity artifacts but does not yet produce a full forward performance summary. Stage 3.8E-2F-1 likely needs either a dedicated E1R OOS engine that mirrors E1 tracking or a wrapper that reuses src/oos tracking primitives with E1R target positions/actions.

decision.recommended_path: Reuse E1 OOS accounting/export primitives through an E1R-specific runner and E1R-specific state/export namespace.

proposed_files_to_modify.purpose: Make this the official E1R v0.2 forward runner. Generate daily target/actions, update E1R-only state, and write performance exports.
Either fold into official runner or make it a helper for E1R daily mark-to-market. Avoid duplicate accounting ownership.
Reuse or lightly generalize portfolio state primitives only if needed. No E1 behavior change.
Reuse accounting primitives if already parameterizable. Prefer wrapper over changing E1 behavior.
Reuse exporter primitives or add E1R namespace export helpers.
After local smoke validation, add E1R forward runner to daily update pipeline.
Only after exports contain real forward performance fields, map summary/equity fields to UI.

acceptance: Know which outputs are placeholders vs calculated.

acceptance: Runner is idempotent for same date/prices.

acceptance: equity curve has at least one official kickoff row.

acceptance: Daily pipeline updates E1 and E1R independently.

risk_controls: Do not modify frozen historical E1R strategy/backtest logic.
Do not use E1 portfolio_state.json for E1R.
Do not label backfilled rows as official OOS.
Do not infer E1R forward performance from historical E1R backtest summary.
Use smoke tests before GitHub Actions integration.

Keep E1 and E1R export namespaces separate.
